captions_note: the receipt sits above the head and the reel's captions stay on over the chest
in_a_reel: TEXT is the sentence the speaker says, in their words; set HEADER, TO and the total line in the reel's language; no real product's name or logo
the slot must run about 1 s past the end of the sentence, so the paper can tear off and leave
steps: edit TEXT, HEADER, TO, TOTAL_LABEL and TOTAL_VALUE in the CLIP block
run build.py SAFE=1      # prints the receipt size, its timing and the snapshot times
run check.py      # frame count, work/check/sheet.jpg, phone copy
